preconditions.description: The number of people in the tree is between 1 and 105, inclusive.
Each person's parent number is between 1 and n, or 0 if the person has no parent.

preconditions.expression: Family relationships do not form cycles.
preconditions.description: There is no person who is his own ancestor, directly or indirectly.
The number of queries is between 1 and 105, inclusive.
Each query contains two integers vi and pi, both between 1 and n, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: The output contains m space-separated integers.
postconditions.description: Each integer is the number of pi-th cousins that person vi has.

postconditions.expression: The output integers are in the order of the queries in the input.
postconditions.description: Each output integer corresponds to the query immediately following it in the input.
